verdict.rationale: Reducto's Parse returns figures as typed elements with page position and bounding boxes, and agentic r-1 mode offers advanced chart extraction, so figures are traceable to the source page. All of this comes from vendor docs with no hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of VLM-generated figure descriptions/summaries, image-crop output for figures, and independent or hands-on corroboration of figure/chart extraction quality.
